paragraphs: Citigroup Inc. or Citi (stylized as citi) is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company based in New York City. The company was formed in 1998 by the merger of Citicorp, the bank holding company for Citibank, and Travelers; Travelers was spun off from the company in 2002.

Citigroup is the third-largest banking institution in the United States by assets; alongside JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo, it is one of the Big Four banking institutions of the United States. It is considered a systemically important bank by the Financial Stability Board and is commonly called "too big to fail". It is one of the eight global investment banks in the Bulge Bracket. Citigroup is ranked 36th on the Fortune 500, and was ranked #24 in Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.The company has assets under management of around US$2.8T.

Citigroup operates across five core businesses: Banking & International, which provides investment banking, corporate banking, and commercial banking services; Markets, which provides sales and trading services; Services (formerly known as Treasury and Trade Solutions, or TTS), which provides cash management, payments, trade finance, liquidity management, securities services, and custody banking to corporations, financial institutions, and public-sector clients; Wealth, which comprises Citi's wealth management and retail banking businesses and includes Citibank; and U.S. Consumer Cards, which is the third-largest issuer of credit cards in the United States.

people.name: Nadir Darrah
people.title: Chief Auditor
people.bio: Darrah joined Citi in 2015 and became Chief Auditor in March 2022. He previously served as Chief Auditor of Citibank, N.A. Data and Transformation.
people.quote: Mr. Darrah joined Citi in 2015 and assumed his current position in March 2022.

people.name: Jane Fraser
people.title: Chair of the Board and Chief Executive Officer, Citigroup Inc.
people.bio: Fraser became CEO in March 2021 and was appointed Board Chair in October 2025. She previously served as CEO of Global Consumer Banking and CEO of Citi Latin America.
people.quote: Ms. Fraser joined Citi in 2004 and assumed her current position in March 2021,

people.name: Sunil Garg
people.title: CEO, Citibank, N.A., and Head of North America
people.bio: Garg assumed his CEO position in February 2021 and also became Head of North America in January 2023. He previously served as global CEO of the Commercial Bank beginning in 2011.
people.quote: Mr. Garg joined Citi in 1988 and assumed his current position in February 2021,

people.name: Nicole Giles
people.title: Controller and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Giles joined Citi as Controller and Chief Accounting Officer in February 2025. She previously spent almost three decades at JPMorgan Chase, most recently as chief financial officer of its commercial and investment banking unit.
people.quote: Ms. Giles joined Citi and assumed her current position in February 2025.

people.name: Pam Habner
people.title: Head of U.S. Consumer Cards
people.bio: Habner joined Citi in 2020 and assumed her current position in November 2025. Previously, she was Head of Consumer Branch Banking and Wealth Management at JPMorgan Chase.
people.quote: Ms. Habner joined Citi in 2020 and assumed her current position in November 2025.

people.name: Shahmir Khaliq
people.title: Head of Services
people.bio: Khaliq became Head of Services in November 2023. He previously served as Global Head of TTS from 2021 to 2023 and as Head of TTS Operations and Technology.
people.quote: Mr. Khaliq joined Citi in 1991 and assumed his current position in November 2023.

people.name: David Livingstone
people.title: Chief Client Officer
people.bio: Livingstone became Chief Client Officer in September 2023. He previously served as CEO of Citi's EMEA region and Country Officer for Australia and New Zealand.
people.quote: Mr. Livingstone joined Citi in 2016 and assumed his current position in September 2023.

people.name: Gonzalo Luchetti
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Luchetti became Chief Financial Officer effective March 2, 2026, after serving as Head of U.S. Personal Banking. His earlier roles included Head of the Consumer Bank in Asia and EMEA.
people.quote: Mr. Luchetti will become Citigroup's Chief Financial Officer effective March 2, 2026.

people.name: Mark A. L. Mason
people.title: Executive Vice Chair of Citi and Senior Executive Advisor to Citi's Chair and CEO
people.bio: Mason retired as Chief Financial Officer effective March 2, 2026, with his transition to Executive Vice Chair and Senior Executive Advisor effective that date; both are non-Board roles. He had served as Chief Financial Officer since 2019.
people.quote: Mr. Mason will become Executive Vice Chair of Citi and Senior Executive Advisor to Citi's Chair and CEO

people.name: Brent McIntosh
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: McIntosh joined Citi in his current position in October 2021. He previously served as the U.S. Treasury's Under Secretary for International Affairs and General Counsel.
people.quote: Mr. McIntosh joined Citi in his current position in October 2021.

people.name: Andrew Morton
people.title: Head of Markets
people.bio: Morton became Head of Markets in March 2022 after serving as Co-Head of Markets and Head of the G10 Rates and Financing businesses. Before joining Citi, he spent 15 years at Lehman Brothers.
people.quote: Mr. Morton joined Citi in 2008 and assumed his current position in March 2022.

people.name: Vis Raghavan
people.title: Head of Banking and Executive Vice Chair
people.bio: Raghavan joined Citi in his current position in June 2024. Previously, he was Head of Global Investment Banking at JPMorgan and had also served as its CEO for Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
people.quote: Mr. Raghavan joined Citi in his current position in June 2024.

people.name: Tim Ryan
people.title: Head of Technology and Business Enablement
people.bio: Ryan joined Citi in his current position in June 2024. He has over 30 years of diversified financial services experience in the U.S. and internationally.
people.quote: Mr. Ryan joined Citi in his current position in June 2024.
